content.title: How to watch the iHeartRadio Music Awards 2026 tonight for free
content.text: Updated: Mar. 26, 2026, 6:24 p.m.Published: Mar. 26, 2026, 6:23 p.m.Rozonda "Chili" Thomas, left, and Tionne "T-Boz" Watkins of 'TLC' arrive at the IHeartRadio Music Awards on Thursday, March 26, 2026, at the Dolby Theatre in Los Angeles. (Photo by Jordan Strauss/Invision/AP)Jordan Strauss/Invision/APIf you purchase a product through a link on our site, we may receive compensation.By Ariana Tourangeau | atourangeau@masslive.comThe iHeartRadio Music Awards will honor this year’s most-played artists and songs and will premiere on Thursday, March 26. The awards will air at 8 p.m. ET on FOX. Those without cable can watch the show for free through FuboTV or DIRECTV, each of which offers a free trial to new users. Sling is another option for streaming the show and promotional offers are available.This year’s iHeartRadio Music Awards will feature award presentations in multiple categories, live performances from the biggest artists in music and surprise guests.The iHeartRadio Music Awards are hosted by rapper and actor Ludacris and will have performances by Lainey Wilson, Ludacris, John Mellencamp, Alex Warren, RAYE, Kehlani and TLC, Salt-N-Pepa, and En Vogue.John Mellencamp will accept the Icon Award and Miley Cyrus will accept the Innovator Award. There are 10 nominations for the top award of the night, which is Song of the Year, led by Morgan Wallen’s “Love Somebody,” Alex Warren’s “Ordinary,” and Taylor Swift’s “The Fate of Ophelia.” There are also 10 nominations for the Artist of the Year award. Those nominations include Bad Bunny, Benson Boone, Chris Brown, Jelly Roll, Kendrick Lamar, Lady Gaga, Morgan Wallen, Sabrina Carpenter, Tate McRae, and Taylor Swift. Taylor Swift leads the nominations with nine.
